name: niacinamide + squalane
uses: 1: Cleanse skin to remove impurities. 2: Apply appropriate amount post - cleansing. 3: Use before heavy moisturizers or oils for better absorption.
otcwarn: Do Not Apply on Broken or Irritated Skin. Keep Out of Reach of Children. Avoid Direct Contact with Eyes. If the product gets into your eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water. Discontinue Use if Irritation Occurs: If redness, itching, or irritation develops, stop use and consult a dermatologist.
